framework_name: SEBI Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework (CSCRF) 2024
regulator: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
section_title: Recognising the need for robust cybersecurity measures and protection of data
breadcrumb: SEBI Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework (CSCRF) 2024 > 1 Recognising the need for robust cybersecurity measures and protection of data
text: 1. Recognising the need for robust cybersecurity measures and protection of data and IT infrastructure, Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has issued 'Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework (CSCRF) for SEBI Regulated Entities (REs) vide circular SEBI/HO/ 13 dated August 20, 2024. Upon receipt of various queries from REs seeking clarification on the aforementioned circular, SEBI has also issued 'Clarifications to Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework (CSCRF) for SEBI Regulated Entities (REs)' vide circular SEBI/HO/ ITD-1/TD_CSC_EXT/P/CIR/2024/184 dated December 31, 2024.

section_title: SEBI had received multiple requests for CSCRF compliance timelines extension
breadcrumb: SEBI Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework (CSCRF) 2024 > 2 SEBI had received multiple requests for CSCRF compliance timelines extension
text: 2. SEBI had received multiple requests for CSCRF compliance timelines extension to ensure ease of compliance for them. Therefore, it has been decided to extend the compliance timelines by three (3) months, i.e., till June 30, 2025 to all REs, except Market Infrastructure Institutions (MIls), KYC Registration Agencies (KRAs), and Qualified Registrars to an Issue and Share Transfer Agents (QRTAs).

2. SEBI had received multiple requests for CSCRF compliance timelines extension to ensure ease of compliance for them. Therefore, it has been decided to extend the compliance timelines by three (3) months, i.e., till June 30, 2025 to all REs, except Market Infrastructure Institutions (MIls), KYC Registration Agencies (KRAs), and Qualified Registrars to an Issue and Share Transfer Agents (QRTAs).
